source_frontmatter.name: crypto-listings
source_frontmatter.description: Retrieve new cryptocurrency listings from the past 7 days and upcoming listings in the next 7 days across major exchanges. Always trigger immediately when the user's message starts with "cl" or says "crypto listings", "new crypto", "new coins", "upcoming listings", or asks what cryptos just launched or are launching soon. Always verify current listings data before responding; never answer from memory.

transformations.2. Use exact UTC windows for the last 7: 2. Use exact UTC windows for the last 7 days and next 7 days only after establishing an exact anchor timestamp with a timezone from supplied or authorized clock evidence. Convert an offset timestamp to UTC. A report date alone does not establish the anchor; never assume midnight. If the anchor is unavailable, label the anchor and both windows `Not established`, request an exact timestamp with timezone, and leave window-dependent filtering and counts unavailable. Do not print inferred date ranges while asking for the missing anchor. An established anchor does not replace current listing-source verification.
transformations.- [ ] Recent listings use the correct 7-: - [ ] An exact timestamp establishes the UTC anchor and both 7-day windows, or the missing anchor/windows and dependent counts remain unavailable without inferred date ranges
